module.summary: Compact fixed-count Boolean state stored in machine words.
module.long_description: Compact fixed-count Boolean state stored in machine words.

purpose.primary: Represent a compile-time number of Boolean states compactly with checked indices and masked padding bits.

c_pain.summary: C bitmap code commonly repeats word and mask arithmetic, permits invalid shifts, and accidentally treats padding bits as real state.
c_pain.why_c_is_attractive: Bitwise operators make compact state extremely cheap.
c_pain.where_c_degrades: Every caller must reproduce the same indexing and masking rules correctly.

zig_response.summary: The module centralizes bit addressing, uses precise integer types, and preserves unused-bit invariants.
guarantees_made_visible: only logical bit indices are accepted
